title: Sixth-moment norm comparison
statement: Let $a,b,\rho\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $\rho^2\le 1/5$. For a uniformly chosen sign $\varepsilon\in\{-1,1\}$, the sixth-norm of $a+\rho b\varepsilon$ is at most the $2$-norm of $a+b\varepsilon$.
